_about: Public-domain William Perkins (1558-1602, Cambridge) for the Word Hoard: the Workes (printed by John Legatt, 1616-1618, 3 vols), from Early English Books scans, raw Internet Archive OCR. The three items are volumes 1-3 of one IA series (sim_pubid 99011), each dated on its record; the printer's name occurs in all three. CCEL and Gutenberg hold nothing of his, and IA has no later collected edition. 17th-century type: the OCR is rough. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 4 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
